executive_summary: The libraries workspace is a mature substrate. Zero production unwraps, 210 JSON schemas, 218 typed IDs, real verification lifecycle with CommitToken enforcement, and a principled authority boundary model. The dominant work is consumption-readiness: ensuring Recall and future consumers can wire into the platform cleanly. No new crates or artifact families should be added during the CLARA closure pass.
confirmed_strengths: CommitToken with private RuntimeSeal — compile-time forgery prevention
forge-pilot OODA loop consumes ExecutionPermit via issue_execution_permit()
GovernanceObservation reads 6 governance surfaces without writing
GovernanceMode::Strict fails closed on missing artifacts
effect-runtime: full intent → preflight → commit → execution receipt → observation bundle lifecycle
semantic-memory: 29K lines, FTS5+HNSW+RRF, graph_view, search_explained, projection storage
knowledge-runtime: query routing, entity resolution, temporal query support
llm-tool-runtime: dispatch, approval, receipt gen, timeout, cancel, typed descriptors
stack-ids: 218 typed ID newtypes with define_id! macro
contract-schema-gen: schema generation from Rust types
Zero production unwraps across all workspace members (excl. Primitives)
